title: Increase-Size Cut on Group Room Blocks Commitments
content:
The commitment share of a Group Room Blocks increase is lowered by an increase-size cut that follows the room nights the increase addendum requests against the room nights contracted at signing, which are the room nights of the block's allocation entry: when they are at least **25 percent** of them, the cut is **20** percentage points; when they are at least **10 percent** but below 25 percent, it is **10** percentage points; below 10 percent there is no cut.

### Questions the rule answers

**Against what is the request measured?** The room nights of the block's allocation entry, the room nights contracted at signing, not the contracted room nights as later changed by addenda.

**Is the request measured in room nights or rooms?** In room nights: the requested room nights written on the signed increase addendum.

### Worked sizes (hypothetical allocation entry of 200 room nights)

| Room nights requested | Share of the allocation | Cut |
|---|---|---|
| 50 | 25 percent | 20 points |
| 49 | 24.5 percent | 10 points |
| 20 | 10 percent | 10 points |
| 19 | 9.5 percent | none |
